news.title: India and India A squads for New Zealand tour announced
matchedLines: Tilak Varma is named in India’s T20I squad as vice-captain.
articleText: The Men’s Selection Committee has announced India and India A squads for the upcoming tour of New Zealand.
India will play five T20Is, while India A will play three Multi-Day matches against New Zealand A.

India’s T20I Squad: Shreyas Iyer (captain), Abhishek Sharma, Sanju Samson, Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, Ishan Kishan, Tilak Varma (vice-captain), Axar Patel, Shivam Dube, Nitish Kumar Reddy, Naman Dhir, Prince Yadav, Mayank Yadav, Arshdeep Singh, Bhuvneshwar Kumar, Varun Chakaravarthy and Kuldeep Yadav.
Source: BCCI. Read the original announcement for the full details.
